subject: Keeping pilot live while PO routes — request for short bridge support
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@novumhealth.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — keep our pilot live while PO routes

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team loved the model responsiveness. We had expected procurement to issue the PO this week but legal flagged one line and routing has stalled. Finance says the PO will be in flight but could take 10–14 business days.

We have active stakeholders (product & ML) who are running integration tests and we risk losing momentum if the sandbox shuts off. Would Redwood be able to provide a short bridge (tokens or extension) until the PO clears? Even a two-week continuation would let us complete our acceptance tests and lock the scope.

I attached a purchase intent note from our procurement team to show the PO is in progress. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Elena Torres
Lead PM, Novum Health
[Attachment: purchase_intent.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: camila.reyes@redwood.ai
To: Elena Torres <elena@novumhealth.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — keep our pilot live while PO routes

Elena —

Really appreciate the heads-up and the purchase intent PDF. Glad the demo landed well. We can absolutely help avoid a stop-gap here.

Short proposal: we can front a 14-day sandbox extension that includes a one-time 5k token top-up and maintain the current sandbox configuration while your PO routes. To go beyond that (or if you need priority dedicated capacity) I’ll need a quick internal approval.

Can you confirm: (1) expected PO ETA (best estimate), (2) whether the acceptance tests are timeboxed (any firm deadlines), and (3) if there are any compliance docs outstanding? That helps me scope the internal ask.

I’m looping in Lauren for help coordinating the approval and then Ben on a sign-off if we need to extend credits beyond the 14 days.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: Quick ask — Novum needs a short bridge while PO routes (DEAL-4872)

Ben / Lauren — forwarding a quick request from Novum Health (DEAL-4872). Procurement routed a purchase intent but the formal PO may take up to 10 business days due to a legal clause. Customer asks for a 14-day sandbox extension + 5k token top-up to finish acceptance test runs.

Why I’m asking for a quick decision: the buyer is technically engaged, this is time-sensitive for their pilot momentum, and we have a strong chance to convert if tests complete successfully. Cost to Redwood: small (equivalent to ~$2.5k runtime). Proposal options:
- Option A (low risk): Apply 14-day extension + 5k token credit now.
- Option B (medium): Option A + additional 14-day voucher if PO ETA slips (requires exec sign-off).

Attachments: purchase_intent.pdf (from customer). I’m recommending Option A to maintain momentum. If approved I’ll apply credits and email CS to monitor usage and unblock the PO once received.

Quick ask: can you approve Option A? If yes, I’ll send an approval note to the customer and tie the credit to DEAL-4872 in HubSpot.

—Camila
